name: lexicon
description: Co-hosted Lexicon and Laxicon workflows for coding agents. Lexicon keeps human and agent aligned on a small typed XML cold layer through grounding and crystallization. Laxicon is the human-governed, prose-first sibling contract for ideas, a human-facing wiki, durable architectural specs, disposable execution plans, provenance, and lifecycle. Ships three skills: `using-lexicon`, `lexicon`, and `laxicon`, plus the existing Lexicon slash commands and local viewer.
